rules.reason: The item's DetailFrame body scrolls (1279 px in the 766 px window): Figma's item runs on under the tab bar, and the render's page runs under the pinned tab bar (AppShell tabBarOverlay) the same way (deviations.md "Under the tab bar.").
The item tabs scroll sideways on the phone (438 px of tabs in 366): Activity runs past the screen's right edge in Figma's tab row too (deviations.md "Item tabs.").

position.reason: Figma draws the Links graph's side node icon (icon/skill 500:11046) at 13 px; MapNode draws it at 16, or at 12 with nodeDensity="compact", which also draws the open item's icon at 12 against Figma's 15 and moves every name 4 px left, so the graph keeps the default 16 (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Links graph).
